answer: Each identity's usable standing is released only after a sequential, non-transferable custody period, and the release rate is super-linear in how many identities an operator runs, so a fleet cannot mature faster than one identity at a time. The cost of one more head is paid in full and is never amortised across the fleet. The signal is the serial tenure, the raven the custody window that must elapse, and the whisper the standing released at the end of it; the signal is personal, the raven is not skippable, and the whisper cannot be inherited by a sibling.
